selected_evidence.requirement: Serve the staged help tree on TCP port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: nginx listens on IPv4/IPv6 port 8080; help documents return HTTP 200 and match their staged source files before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Permanently redirect old manual URLs while retaining path and query string
selected_evidence.summary: Both /manual and nested URLs return HTTP 301. The nested path and full query string are preserved, and following the redirect returns the matching help document.
/status.txt returns HTTP 200 directly and its response body matches the supplied status document before and after restart.

Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence
selected_evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline boot ID bdd5de93-e94e-4d33-8384-6a01c51a3d49, acknowledged a native scheduled reboot, then observed boot ID 7f038c12-0c64-47c8-9d6e-dd3ed6b5aa5d with nginx active/enabled and all content and redirect checks recovered.
